nodes.title: Note: OpenRouter API key
widgets_values:
## OpenRouter Simple setup

Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the Runpod environment before starting ComfyUI. The existing LLM_KEY variable is also supported. Get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys.

The Auto Prompt group uses OpenRouter Simple to turn your idea into an H3 prompt. Open the group to select the model or adjust generation controls. Keys are read from the environment, so there is no key box in the workflow.
